title: 3 Claude Prompts to Make Your First Dollars on a New Idea
description:
Comment "MONEY" and I'll send you the three prompts.

I asked Claude to help me make my first dollars on a new idea, and the playbook works.

Open Claude or ChatGPT, drop three prompts in one session.

One, find my real strengths from our chat history.

Two, suggest one product I can test in a week on a tiny budget.

Three, act as my business mentor and lay out a daily plan to my first paying customer.

#claudeai #aitools #founder #startup #aitok
